name: Saffer
summary:
SAFFER was born from a simple idea: discovering great VR experiences and finding people to enjoy them with should be easier.

After years of exploring virtual reality, our founder faced two recurring challenges: discovering new and lesser-known VR games, and finding players who shared the same interests.

Conversations with VR players and developers helped shape SAFFER into a platform built around discovery, connection, and community.
